plate_comment: With the accelerator interlock enabled and switch 26 on: claims the throttle override with accelerator_interlock_throttle_priority (when it beats the current one) and value 0 (was cm848_checkDiagnosticFuelOverride)

With the remote throttle enabled: mirrors its two fault bits (64-79 0x4000 / 0x2000 -> 160-175 0x800 / 0x1000) and - with switch 31 on or the rate limit check active - claims the throttle override with remote_throttle_priority and the remote throttle value (was cm848_periodicControlLoopFaultHandling)
Seeds crank_four_dimensional_timing and crank_exit_advance with -1024 (0xfc00) (was cm848_initColdStartLimits)

The intake air heater crank phase (e2m 8A35 +2 IAH_Phase 3 = crank): clears relays 43 / 44 on entry, then by the start temperature heats until the low engine speed count or the crank heat time runs out (was cm848_updateIntakeAirHeaterRunupPhase) | earlier note: state 3 run-up - clears relays 43/44 on first entry then holds off (or below-count > 20 / elapsed >= 100) - the 4200 rpm branch (above redline - unreachable) drives relays on - zeroes remaining preheat - sets status bit4 - runs only if start temp <= 66 F (was diag_iat_protection_rpmDerate_update) | review-function-readability reviewed 2026-11-13 - Readability Medium Accuracy Confidence Medium
Returns 1 when cruise is denied and stores the reason code 1-12 in cruise_control_denied_status (and the cutout reason while engaged) (was governor_cruise_deniedStatus_update)
